tasks.gr8-electrical-systems-and-circuit-safet: Topic: Electrical systems and circuit safety. Cover series and parallel circuits, cells, switches, conductors, fuses, circuit breakers, and earthing. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret simple circuit diagrams, compare circuit behaviour, and apply safe electrical practices in realistic scenarios.
tasks.gr8-logic-and-pat-design-work-t2: Topic: Logic and PAT design work. Cover AND logic, OR logic, truth tables, control-system thinking, and panic-button design contexts. Ask Grade 8 learners to evaluate input-output conditions, complete truth-table reasoning, and communicate workable PAT design ideas with clear labels.
tasks.gr8-impact-and-packaging-t2: Topic: Impact of technology and packaging. Cover the positive impact of technology (new or improved materials replacing natural ones, biodegradable materials, recycling waste paper and cardboard into packaging), the plastic shopping bag case study (litter, thicker biodegradable bags that shoppers must buy, evaluating a solution objectively, fairly and accurately with advantages and disadvantages), counteracting the negative impact, and packaging: the nature of the product determines the design and material, and the development (net) of an opened container with the surface area of a box. Ask Grade 8 learners to evaluate, choose packaging and calculate the area of a net.
tasks.gr8-forces-on-materials-t2: Topic: Forces on materials and reinforcing. Cover tension, compression, bending, torsion and shear with everyday examples, reinforcing concrete (steel bars in the tension side, the bottom of a loaded beam), plywood (layers with grain at right angles), and metal sections (I-beam, angle iron, T-bar, channel) that withstand forces and save material, with a computed comparison of cross-section areas. Ask Grade 8 learners to name forces, say where reinforcing goes and compare sections.
